title: pluchea odorata var. normalis
intro: Pluchea odorata var. normalis, commonly known as Fingerroot, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits that include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Fingerroot include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Pluchea odorata var. normalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
